title: Buttery Succotash with Corn and Lima Beans
summary: Fresh corn with its milky pulp, frozen lima beans, onion and red pepper cooked in butter with a pinch of cayenne and parsley.

ingredients.item: red pepper, cut into 1 cm dice
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Strip the corn
steps.text: Stand each cob in the bowl and slice down the sides to cut off the kernels. Scrape the cob firmly with the back of the knife to catch the sweet, milky pulp, which gives the dish its creamy body.

steps.title: Soften the vegetables
steps.text: Melt the butter in the frying pan over medium-high heat until the foaming dies down. Cook the onion and red pepper for about 5 min, until soft and just browning at the edges, then add the garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.

steps.title: Cook the corn and beans
steps.text: Stir in the corn and pulp, frozen lima beans, salt, pepper and cayenne. Turn the heat to medium and cook for about 5 min, stirring occasionally, until the beans are tender and everything is hot.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in the parsley and serve straight away while the colours are bright.

tips: Frozen corn works out of season; add it straight from frozen.
Frozen baby lima beans are often sold as baby butter beans.
Do not overcook, or the corn loses its crisp sweetness.
Add a squeeze of lemon if you like it sharper.
storage: Refrigerate covered up to 3 days. Reheat in a frying pan with a knob of butter until piping hot (74 °C). Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
